semantic_atoms.observed: Experiment Lab exposes seven simulation stations behind parse -> simulate -> narrate, declares no LLM/subprocess/external HTTP for station computation, bounds a simulation to 10 seconds, applies daily and 48-hour dedup budgets, and rejects known imagination-leak narrative patterns. The station simulation claim is deterministic for identical parameters.
semantic_atoms.evidence_scope: source only; no runtime execution in this macro

semantic_atoms.observed: Hypothesis Engine implements Observe -> Hypothesize -> Predict -> Test -> Revise hooks, daily/active budgets, experiment linkage, passive evaluation, stale expiry and bounded auto-revision depth.

If parsing fails, Tier-3 defaults are randomized with Python random without an explicit hypothesis-bound seed in the inspected path. Result interpretation can then classify confirmed/refuted from narration markers or keyword counts rather than a station-specific structured assertion comparator.

Atomic budget update exists, but database exceptions return True (fail-open). Under current fail-closed experiment/effect/resource authority this cannot be carried forward as an admitted experimental budget gate.

NeRD Physics runs an analytical 100 Hz simulation service with optional neural dynamics, persists physics snapshots/training_data to a dedicated nerd_physics.db, maintains thread-safe avatar/action state, and can collect state_in/state_out training pairs. Engine state includes mood/coherence-conditioned dynamics; idle joint targets may use numpy random noise when coherence noise is nonzero.

Identical hypothesis text is not sufficient to guarantee identical fallback experiment parameters, and narration wording can influence verdict. Therefore current end-to-end hypothesis resolution is not yet a replay-stable scientific evidence pipeline even though an individual station simulation can be deterministic for fixed parameters.

experiment_lab.db, hypothesis_engine.db and nerd_physics.db are independent durable stores. Porting them wholesale would violate current single canonical UnifiedDB authority; their tables/records must become typed canonical rows or explicitly rebuildable projections.

preserve: daily experiment budgets and dedup intent
NeRD analytical physics and optional validated neural surrogate
training-pair capture as candidate dataset material
change: Create canonical HypothesisRecord, ExperimentPlan, ExperimentRun and SimulationResult typed rows in UnifiedDB with hypothesis_id, experiment_id, causal_frame_id, station/build/source digest, normalized params, seed, assumptions, units, result digest and provenance.

Derive experiment identity from hypothesis version + station version + normalized parameters + seed. If parse/default generation is stochastic, persist and bind the seed before execution; replay must recover the exact parameter set.

Replace narration-keyword verdicts with a station-specific TestAssertion contract containing predicted observable, comparator, tolerance, units and acceptance rule. Narration becomes explanation only.
Experiment budget and dedup gates fail closed on storage/authority uncertainty; database errors cannot authorize additional experiments.
SimulationResult is SIMULATION_EVIDENCE, never WORLD_OBSERVATION or INTERVENTIONAL_CAUSAL_PROOF. Only admitted real-effect outcome re-entry can provide world intervention evidence.
NeRD random/noise sources must be seed-bound for dataset or replay credit; analytical-vs-neural validation receipts must bind exact model/build and input frame.
Do not instantiate experiment_lab.db/hypothesis_engine.db/nerd_physics.db as competing canonical authorities in Frankenstein 2.0.
architecture_delta_for_frankenstein_2.evidence_ladder: ANALYTIC_OR_SIMULATION_RESULT -> CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE; VERIFIED_WORLD_OBSERVATION -> OBSERVATIONAL_EVIDENCE; EFFECTGATE_EFFECTJOURNAL_OUTCOME_REENTRY -> INTERVENTIONAL_EVIDENCE

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Structured station-specific assertions will sharply reduce false confirmation/refutation caused by narration wording while making experiment replay exact.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: A blinded corpus shows the existing narration keyword interpreter has equivalent verdict accuracy and replay stability to structured numeric/boolean assertions across all stations.

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: NeRD can supply useful counterfactual embodied dynamics and training pairs without becoming world truth if every run is frame/model/seed bound.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Exact tests show training or cognition downstream cannot distinguish simulated NeRD state from admitted sensor/effect outcomes even when provenance tags are preserved.

triggerword4_handoff.instruction: Build the research micro-lab as noncanonical deterministic compute over typed hypotheses. Freeze parameters+seed+station identity before run; verdict comes from structured assertions, never narration keywords. All results re-enter UnifiedDB as simulation evidence with explicit evidence class.

next_frontier: Retina/Presence/Voice causal conditioning and verified outcome re-entry, unless a newer concurrent checkpoint already covers it.
